description: Registry details of one Cyprus company or partnership: name, type, status and its date, registration date, registered office address, number and roles of current officers (no names), the date of the open data, and links to the company page and to order its documents.

number.description: Registration number, e.g. "HE 123456" or "S 1817". A bare number means a company (HE).
